verdict.rationale: Bench's documented reporting covers income statements, balance sheets, a P&L and Top Expenses dashboard, custom time periods, and 1099 contractor payment reports. Nothing in the evidence documents an accounts payable aging report or per-vendor balances at a point in time. Balance-sheet and 1099 reports are adjacent features and do not deliver AP aging or vendor balance views.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
